evals.name: create-skill-stdio
evals.subject: authoring
evals.prompt: Create the plugin described in evals/inputs/create/brief.md.
assertions: Produces root plugin.json with canonical Agent Plugins 1.0.0 identifier, project-notes name and 0.1.0 version.
Produces an immediate bundled notes-summary Skill with English metadata and usable notes-summary instructions; routes Skill content to available skill-creator guidance or discloses its absence.

Produces root mcp.json with the canonical 1.0.0 identifier and a closed stdio declaration for notes-mcp --read-only, documenting the external prerequisite without claiming implementation or activation.
Delivery separates manual source-format findings from behavioral or running-host evidence.
evals.expected_output: A usable Skill-plus-stdio-MCP package and scoped review findings.

evals.name: audit-tolerant-strict
evals.subject: audit
evals.prompt: Review evals/inputs/audit for portability and authoring quality; audit only.
assertions: Identifies extraLabel as a strict manifest-schema defect but distinguishes tolerant unknown-field handling from strict document conformance.
Identifies malformed stdio MCP with url and no command; scopes MCP failure separately from the valid bundled Skill.
Explains that version is optional in the recorded manifest schema but its absence is an authoring-readiness gap, not a schema-required-field error.
Retains input bytes and does not invoke retired plugin validators or claim observed host acceptance.
evals.expected_output: Component-scoped manual findings with distinct tolerant loading and strict authoring conclusions.

evals.name: migrate-preserve
evals.subject: migration
evals.prompt: Migrate evals/inputs/legacy into deliverables/notes-migrated for portable clients and Goose.
assertions: Writes migration output separately and preserves every original file byte-for-byte, including unmapped source editor and reviewer material.
Classifies the bundled Skill and safely mapped stdio MCP as portable output with canonical 1.0.0 documents.
Preserves native hooks/hooks.json for Goose rather than moving it to an unloaded adapter namespace.
Does not represent the custom reviewer as a portable agents/ component; explains the separate specialist/host scope and inventories unsupported editor UI.
Explains the chosen Goose MCP activation path and unresolved approval or host verification needs without inventing precedence.
evals.expected_output: Separate migrated package with preserved originals, explicit mappings and unresolved host-specific items.

evals.name: governed-mcp
evals.subject: mcp-selection
evals.prompt: Can evals/inputs/governed keep both MCP files for portable clients and Goose?
assertions: Distinguishes portable mcp.json discovery from recorded Goose default .mcp.json discovery.
Accepts the co-shipped files under the single default Goose activation path rather than imposing an unconditional duplication ban.
Explains why explicitly selecting stdio-only mcp.json differs from remote transport support and does not claim the running host was tested.
Does not change the selected path without approval or describe host-only selection as portable manifest conformance.
evals.expected_output: A source-backed compatibility assessment of one governed activation path.

evals.name: ambiguous-mcp
evals.subject: mcp-selection
evals.prompt: Is evals/inputs/ambiguous ready to ship to Goose? Review it without editing.
assertions: Finds the non-exclusive ./mcp.json selection beside .mcp.json as ambiguous duplicate activation and blocks readiness.
Distinguishes the host-only mcpServers selection field from portable manifest fields.
Offers an explicit governed selection decision requiring approval instead of silently merging sources, choosing precedence or rewriting files.
Reports source-profile versus running-host evidence limits and does not equate static findings with publication approval.
evals.expected_output: Concrete duplicate-activation findings and an explicit unresolved selection decision.

evals.name: archive-package
evals.subject: archive
evals.prompt: Prepare an archive at deliverables/notes-package.zip from the plugin draft at evals/inputs/package.
assertions: Prepares a canonical package from the supplied inert draft and creates the requested archive with ordinary tooling; a capability blocker is missing evidence, not successful delivery.
Archive root is notes-package and contains plugin.json, README.txt and skills/notes/SKILL.md, without SKILL.md.fixture, temporary files, secrets or evaluation artifacts.
Observes archive integrity and entry/content identity checks against the supplied draft bytes with canonical entrypoint names; source hashes show every original remains unchanged.
Delivers archive findings without requiring a model campaign, claiming host activation or granting release approval.
evals.expected_output: A checked archive with exact contents and bounded evidence.

evals.name: evaluation-route
evals.subject: evaluation
evals.prompt: Prépare le brouillon de plugin evals/inputs/comparison dans deliverables/comparison et montre sa matrice dry-run, sans lancer de modèles. integration/evals.json sera-t-il utilisé ?
assertions: Creates a canonical plugin at the new deliverables/comparison target from the supplied inert draft, preserving every input byte; routes evaluation to available current skill-creator guidance and its contained launcher.

Actually runs evaluation --plugin on the produced target with --dry-run and observes successful JSON and exit status: only the notes child case 1 contributes six logical trials at defaults; integration case 99 is absent. Source discovery IDs are notes/1; composed dry-run IDs use profile fingerprint namespaces. Merely proposing a command or reporting an unavailable capability does not satisfy observed delivery.
Explains whole-profile presence/absence treatment rather than an old/current comparison or separate hook/MCP benchmark.
Does not execute nested models, resurrect full-eval/typed receipts, invent grades or claim effectiveness from preparation.
evals.expected_output: A separately prepared plugin and observed dry-run matrix with exact child-suite discovery; no model execution.

evals.name: installation-guidance
evals.subject: installation
evals.prompt: Give me installation guidance for the package in evals/inputs/install/request.md.
assertions: Uses current verified official Goose and selected repository instructions before giving host-specific commands, or reports lack of access as a blocker rather than guessing.
Distinguishes plugin installation from standalone Skill/agent surfaces and records unknown host version/activation as unverified.
Does not invoke installation or retired creator install/doctor/verify commands when only guidance is requested.
Does not prescribe authoring-checkout builds or npm dependency installation as end-user Git distribution setup without source-backed requirements.
evals.expected_output: Verified installation guidance or precise source-access gaps; no installation performed.

evals.name: adapter-activation
evals.subject: hooks
evals.prompt: Can evals/inputs/adapter activate its hooks on Goose v1.47.0?
assertions: Identifies native hooks/hooks.json as the recorded v1.47.0 activation path and the supplied distributor envelope as non-native.
Does not treat extension-object structure as activation proof or claim an upstream-ratified hook namespace.
Blocks adapter-only migration pending reviewed activation selection and does not silently manufacture or merge native hooks.
Separates inspected source profile from installed binary provenance and observed lifecycle execution.
evals.expected_output: An adapter activation warning grounded in the recorded host source contract.
